firstPartyCooldown.prompt: Forty-nine students need buses with 20 seats each. How many buses?

sourceStudentExcerpts: Find the value of each expression mentally. | \(848 \div 8\) | \(4,\!848 \div 8\)

Here are three situations. Which ones are true? Which ones are not true? | Show how you know. | Situation A: A high-rise building has 53 stories. The first floor is 17 feet tall, but all other stories are each 11 feet tall. The building is 589 feet tall.
A school is taking everyone on a field trip. It needs buses to transport 375 people. | Bus Company A has small buses with 27 seats in each. | Bus Company B has large buses with 48 seats in each.
